answer: Rule: every new identity docks in a harbor before it can earn. Inside, it takes micro-tasks whose outputs are cross-checked against two random peers on a trellis, and each task carries a quartz proof that real time was spent. A fake that mismatches its trellis partners forfeits a 25 POA harbor bond. One operator running 100 fakes pays 25 POA per fake plus the full wall-clock time of every task, so the cost scales linearly in bonds and compounds in time.
